selector.rationale: Evidence of perineural invasion by malignant melanoma is strongly supported by histopathologic findings and imaging studies, including the frontal nerve biopsy showing malignant cells with mitotic activity and the MRI finding of a left superior orbit mass extending along the supraorbital nerve to the cavernous sinus.

rejected.label: Desmoplastic Melanoma
rejected.why: Lack of specific evidence supporting desmoplastic melanoma in the vignette

rejected.label: Cavernous sinus syndrome
rejected.why: While the MRI shows extension to the cavernous sinus, the primary diagnosis is perineural invasion by malignant melanoma
